Job Description:
 

   Sigmatech is seeking an Operations Research Analyst (ORSA) to join our team at Schriever SFB in Colorado Springs, CO.


 


 Successful candidates should have a strong understanding of the development and implementation of mathematical and statistical models to solve various problems across multiple domains. Experience and familiarity with the space domain is preferred.


 Active TS/SCI clearance required


 Responsibilities:


 
  Application of Technical expertise contributing to projects which use: applied mathematics, operations research, data analytics, modeling and simulation, and decision analysis
  Determining the level of analytic rigor required for analysis based on the complexity of the mission area being assessed and the uncertainties of the supporting data
  Understanding customer requirements, adjusting analytical efforts to meet those requirements, and effectively communicating results
  Ability to coordinate with senior managers and decision makers to identify and solve a variety of problems and to clarify management objectives
  Work as part of a contractor team working alongside a broader team of government and contract staff
 
 
 Experience and Skills:
 Required Skills and Experience:


 
  Bachelor of Science degree in operations research, systems engineering, or related technical field
  7+ years of experience
  Design of experiments experience
  Ability to lead a team of highly skilled analysts on projects with notable risk and complexity.
  Develops and implements new processes/procedures as needed. Provides direction/guidance as required.
  Strong quantitative and analytic abilities to integrate and analyze data
  Technical skill in operations research, modeling and simulation, computer science, big-data analytics, or similar disciplines
  Ability to effectively communicate complex concepts to audiences of varying backgrounds
  Willingness to learn new technical and management domains
  The ability to work in a secure, confined location (i.e., SCIF)
  High motivation, creativity, and flexibility to work in a dynamic environment
  TS/SCI clearance required
 
 


 Preferred Skills and Experience:


 
  A Masters in operations research or a theoretical science field
  Experience in DoD space and joint force programs
  Programming experience with Python, MATLAB, R, SQL, VBA
  Experience developing and implementing mathematical and statistical models
  Experience with Excel VBA
 
 In compliance with Colorado's Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the salary range for this role is $145,000 to $155,000; however, Sigmatech considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, experience, education/training, key skills, location and often contractual requirements.

GS-9: You must have completed 2 years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to a masters degree or masters or equivalent graduate degree or one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least a GS-07 at the graduate level in one of the following:

jobs_results.description: Title: Operations Research Analyst Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR! KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security. Why Join Us? Innovative Projects: KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions. Collaborative Environment: Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace. Impactful Work: Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense. Position Summary: The Entry to Mid‑Level Operations Research Analyst applies operations research methods and mathematical modeling to support decision‑making and policy development. The analyst collects and analyzes data, develops decision‑support tools, and uses modern analytical techniques to generate insights. The focus of analysis centers on logistics feasibility, specifically as it relates to munitions and fuels posture and resupply problem sets. Further, the analyst will work modeling and simulation with a focus on campaign-level analysis to explore the impact of new warfighting concepts and capabilities on campaign outcomes. They collaborate with team members on studies that improve processes, strengthen system performance, and enhance operational effectiveness. Key Responsibilities: Analysis Apply foundational knowledge of operations research, mathematics, and analytical techniques to support project objectives. Work with project leads to clarify analytical goals and develop task plans aligned with management priorities. Collaborate with team members to conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses that inform decision‑making. Contribute to studies that evaluate, improve, and validate decision‑analytic models, simulations, and methodologies. Communication Document analysis using analytical models, simulations, visualizations, or decision‑support tools. Prepare clear, concise briefings, technical papers, and summary reports to communicate findings and recommendations. Present analytical results, insights, and techniques to customers, project teams, and peers. Innovation Identify opportunities to enhance analytical methods and share creative, well‑supported solutions to complex problems. Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute new ideas that strengthen project outcomes. Technical Expertise Stay current on emerging analytical tools, modeling techniques, and domain‑relevant technologies. Actively pursue professional development to deepen expertise in operations research, related disciplines, and domain knowledge. Work Environment: Location: Onsite with time split between KBR facility in Dayton, OH and Wright-Patterson AFB, OH Travel Requirements: Minimal Working Hours: Standard Qualifications: Required BA/BS degree in operations research, mathematics, industrial engineering, or a related field Fundamental knowledge of applying scientific methods and analytical techniques to systems and software Experience with at least one analytical or statistical language/tool (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, SAS, VBA, Java, SimPy, Simio, Gurobi, and JMP) Basic experience (coursework, internship, or project‑based) developing or utilizing analytical models using Python, R, or C++ Ability to analyze and interpret problems and recommend effective solutions Ability to quickly learn customer missions, systems, and problem domains Ability to obtain a DoD Top Secret clearance Preferred MS degree in operations research, mathematics, industrial engineering, or a related field 2–4 years of experience applying scientific methods and techniques to analyze systems (e.g., professional work, DoD programs, and national security analytics) Familiarity with DoD systems, weapon subsystem design, or military operations Proficiency with multiple analytical tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, SAS, VBA, Java, SimPy, Simio, Gurobi, and JMP) Experience designing and developing analytical models using Python, R, and/or C++ Demonstrated initiative in learning and applying new analytic techniques Active DoD Secret or Top Secret clearance Experience working in military logistics related fields Ready to Make a Difference? If you’re excited about making a significant impact in the field of space defense and working on projects that matter, we encourage you to apply and join our team at KBR. Let's shape the future together. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. In everything we do, we are guided by our ONE KBR Values: We Value Our People – We create diverse, inclusive environments in which each person can feel safe, respected and valued, and where everyone has opportunities to grow and reach their full potential. We Deliver – We are uncompromising in our commitment to deliver innovative, high-quality, technology-led solutions for our customers and exceptional, sustainable value for all our stakeholders. We Are People of Integrity – We value honesty, trust, courage, fairness, prudence and tenacity. We believe doing what’s right for the planet, the communities where we work, and our people is good for business.
